title: Toby the Little Tugboat and the Sunset Island Lullaby
description: A little teal tugboat and a peach-sailed friend carry muffins and a tiny music-box lullaby to Sunset Island, then settle into a quiet cove to sleep under the moon.

Toby.color: Deep teal-blue hull with a cream upper cabin, warm coral-red roof and smokestack band, and pale-yellow side windows
Toby.bodyShape: Small rounded tugboat with a short coral-red smokestack, black rubber bow bumper, compact rear cargo deck, and no arms, hands, legs, or clothing
Toby.face: Large expressive brown eyes on the front cabin windshield and a small friendly smile on the cream front panel below
Toby.accessories: A single small brass bell above the cabin, plus a light wicker muffin basket and a honey-brown wooden music box on the rear deck

Shelly.role: Supporting character; a little sailboat who first appears on page 5
Shelly.color: Glossy ivory-white hull with a narrow dusty-rose stripe and one softly curved peach triangular sail
Shelly.bodyShape: Petite rounded sailboat slightly smaller than Toby, with a short natural-wood mast and simple hull; no cabin, arms, hands, legs, or clothing
Shelly.face: Large expressive hazel eyes on the front-facing bow with a small sweet smile beneath them
Shelly.accessories: None beyond the fixed peach sail and dusty-rose stripe

settingBible.Harbor and Sunset Island: A peaceful coastal harbor with a honey-brown dock and pastel cottages, connected by calm turquoise water to Sunset Island with its short dock, pastel cottages, palm trees, flowering bushes, and sheltered crescent cove
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded boats, golden afternoon fading to moonlit blue, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Toby keeps his teal hull, cream cabin, coral-red roof and smokestack, brass bell, and rear-deck muffin basket and music box.
Shelly stays a smaller ivory sailboat with a peach sail and dusty-rose stripe, and first appears on page 5.
Narration never states exactly when the music box opens or closes, because art may differ on pages 4, 6, and 14.
Pages 14–15 keep both boats resting in the same sheltered island cove; both are fully asleep on page 15.
No rescue, danger, stormy seas, lettering, logos, or extra named boat characters.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: In a peaceful seaside harbor lived Toby, a little tugboat who loved the gentle sounds of the ocean.
pages.illustrationScene: Teal tugboat Toby floats alone beside a wooden harbor dock under a golden afternoon sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby alone; Shelly absent. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Every evening, Toby listened to the waves swish, the seabirds hum, and the harbor bells softly chime.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby smiles beside the dock as two white seabirds glide overhead over calm shimmering water.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby alone; Shelly absent. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: One lovely afternoon, Toby filled his little deck with sweet berry muffins and a tiny wooden music box.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby at the dock with a wicker muffin basket and a tiny wooden music box on his rear cargo deck.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby alone; Shelly absent. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Tonight, I'll bring a bedtime song to Sunset Island, Toby said with a cheerful little toot.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby departs the harbor with muffins and music box on deck, leaving a soft curved wake at sunset.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby alone; Shelly absent. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Along the way, Toby met Shelly, a little sailboat with a beautiful peach-colored sail.
pages.illustrationScene: Peach-sailed sailboat Shelly first glides alongside Toby on calm open water toward distant island hills.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: May I come too, Shelly asked, saying she knew a song as gentle as the evening breeze.
pages.illustrationScene: Shelly sails close beside welcoming Toby under a glowing sunset sky on calm water.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Together they sailed past sleepy seabirds resting on smooth rocks, listening to the waves whisper good evening.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly pass rounded shoreline rocks where two small white seabirds rest peacefully.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: As the sky turned pink and lavender, Toby's music box shared a delicate melody that floated over the water.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly travel under a pink-lavender sky while a delicate melody floats over the water.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Shelly hummed along, but even the little waves seemed to sway softly with their song.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly travel side by side through gentle ripples with sunset glowing behind island hills.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: At last, Sunset Island appeared, with cozy cottages nestled between flowering bushes and swaying palm trees.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly approach Sunset Island's short dock with pastel cottages, palms, and flowering bushes.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Toby shared the berry muffins with the island's little animals while Shelly sang her sweetest evening tune.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby rests at the dock with muffins beside tiny island animals while Shelly floats nearby singing.
pages.timeOfDay: soft violet blue hour at the dock
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: The island grew quiet as the music box played its final tinkling notes beneath the first sparkling stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly float by the island dock under a violet sky as first stars appear and the island grows quiet.
pages.timeOfDay: violet blue hour with first stars
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: The loveliest songs are the ones we share, Toby whispered, and Shelly gave a happy, sleepy smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Close peaceful view of Toby and Shelly side by side at the island dock under warm windows and early stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state.

pages.text: Toby and Shelly settled into the sheltered island cove, where the water was as smooth as a soft blue blanket.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly rest in the sheltered crescent cove near the island dock beneath a crescent moon.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state. Final cove rest; both asleep on page 15.

pages.text: Beneath the silver moon, the two little boats closed their eyes and drifted into sweet dreams of music, muffins, and gentle seas.
pages.illustrationScene: Toby and Shelly sleep side by side in the protected cove with eyes fully closed under silver moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Toby and Shelly together. Do not narrate exact music-box open/closed state. Final cove rest; both asleep on page 15.
